title: cerastium alpinum var. villosum
intro: Cerastium alpinum var. villosum, commonly known as Woolly Mouse-Ear, is a variety of flowering plant in the carnation family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mouse-Ear include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
